name: Tenable.io — Assets
description: Pull rich asset inventory from Tenable.io via the asset export API (OS, cloud tags, ACR/AES scores, agent metadata, network interfaces)

credential_acquisition.description: Generate API keys in Tenable: Settings → My Account → API Keys → Generate. Paste them below. Requires 'CAN VIEW' access to assets.

fields.label: Access Key
fields.help: From Tenable UI: Settings → My Account → API Keys

fields.label: Secret Key
fields.help: Shown only once when generated — regenerate in Tenable if lost

validation_request.error_message: Could not authenticate with Tenable.io. Check the API keys and try again.

transform.expr: int(value) if value is not None else 5

{'ip': (record.get('ipv4s') or [''])[0], 'hostname': (record.get('hostnames') or [''])[0], 'fqdn': (record.get('fqdns') or [''])[0], 'device_id': value, 'instance_id': (record.get('aws_ec2_instance_id') or record.get('azure_resource_id') or record.get('gcp_instance_id') or ''), 'display_name': (record.get('hostnames') or [''])[0] or (record.get('fqdns') or [''])[0] or (record.get('ipv4s') or [''])[0]}

{'acr_score': record.get('acr_score'), 'aes_score': record.get('aes_score'), 'exposure_score': record.get('exposure_score'), 'system_type': (record.get('system_types') or [''])[0], 'agent_uuid': (record.get('agent_uuids') or [''])[0], 'agent_names': record.get('agent_names') or [], 'has_agent': record.get('has_agent', False), 'has_plugin_results': record.get('has_plugin_results', False), 'last_authenticated_scan_date': record.get('last_authenticated_scan_date', ''), 'last_licensed_scan_date': record.get('last_licensed_scan_date', ''), 'cloud_provider': ('aws' if record.get('aws_ec2_instance_id') else 'azure' if record.get('azure_resource_id') else 'gcp' if record.get('gcp_instance_id') else ''), 'aws_ec2_instance_id': record.get('aws_ec2_instance_id', ''), 'aws_ec2_instance_type': record.get('aws_ec2_instance_type', ''), 'aws_region': record.get('aws_region', ''), 'aws_owner_id': record.get('aws_owner_id', ''), 'azure_resource_id': record.get('azure_resource_id', ''), 'azure_vm_id': record.get('azure_vm_id', ''), 'gcp_project_id': record.get('gcp_project_id', ''), 'gcp_instance_id': record.get('gcp_instance_id', ''), 'gcp_zone': record.get('gcp_zone', ''), 'network_interfaces': record.get('network_interfaces') or [], 'tags': record.get('tags') or []}

chunk_size.description: Number of assets per export chunk

last_assessed.description: Unix timestamp — only include assets last assessed after this time (0 = all)
